name: @afd/example-todo
description: Multi-stack Todo example with AFD patterns

scripts.test:conformance:ts: pnpm --dir backends/typescript build && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend ts
scripts.test:interop: node --import tsx --test dx/cleanup.test.ts && pnpm --dir backends/typescript build && tsx dx/run-interop.ts
scripts.test:conformance:rs: cargo build --locked --manifest-path backends/rust/Cargo.toml && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend rs
scripts.test:conformance:umbel: cd ../../../endpoints/umbel && cargo build --locked -p umbel-todo --bin umbel-todo && cd ../../packages/examples/todo && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend umbel
scripts.test:conformance:umbel-mounted: cd ../../../endpoints/umbel && cargo build --locked -p umbel --bin umbel && cd ../../packages/examples/todo && cargo build --locked --manifest-path backends/rust/Cargo.toml && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend umbel-mounted
scripts.test:conformance:cpp: cmake -S backends/cpp -B backends/cpp/build/release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DAFD_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON && cmake --build backends/cpp/build/release --config Release --target todo-server-cpp && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend cpp
scripts.test:page: pnpm --dir backends/typescript build && pnpm --dir frontends/fast-af build && pnpm --dir frontends/react build && pnpm --dir frontends/fast-af test:browser && pnpm --dir frontends/react test:browser
